verdict.rationale: Zoom Scribe documents several selectable model IDs: zoom-scribe-multilingual (ten languages), whisper (26 additional locales), and zoom-scribe-en-pro, which is described as giving 'higher English accuracy'. So a developer can choose among models, and there is a qualitative accuracy/language tradeoff. Missing for 10: published accuracy figures (e.g. WER), per-model latency figures, per-model cost/pricing comparison, and independent benchmarking of the model differences.
